ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 3:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels occupying the central region to low-intensity dark pixels forming the perimeter and basal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central 70% of the visible fluke area. A dark, low-intensity band (5-15% of total fluke width) outlines the entire trailing edge and lobe tips. Dark pixel clusters are concentrated at the fluke-peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys); right lobe trailing edge presents a smoother, more linear profile with fewer pixel-level deviations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit moderate concavity proximally near the median notch, transitioning to a linear trajectory towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, dark pixel clusters (roughly circular) detected on the white field, primarily localized near the peduncle and along the upper-left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged and irregular pixel boundary at the distal tip of the left lobe suggesting historical tissue loss; significant dark pigmentation/scarring at the fluke base near the waterline.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, thick black border along the entire trailing edge providing a high-contrast boundary against the internal white pigment.
